完整的 YouTube 工作流程演练🌸 :

您可以使用工作流程执行以下操作：

IP2P_MASKING_AUTOMATED_VID2VID：

  • 自动屏蔽您的视频

  • 使用蒙版调节、IPAdapter 和 IP2P ControlNet 变换视频特定部分的形状和纹理

  • 自动迭代视频的不同风格，无需监控

  • 直接在提示中自动添加 IPAdapter 图像描述（使用 LLM）

  • 直接在工作流程中将任何背景与 AI 结果合成

SDXL_TURBO_STYLE_TRANSFER_VID2VID （基于西蒙·李的作品）：

  • 以通用风格统一由不同风格/资源组成的视频输入

  • 使用 SDXL Turbo 对您的视频进行纹理/风格化，从而实现高质量和一致性

  • 根据输入图像风格自动调整色度

  • 使用升级器和多通道 KSampler 升级您的输入视频分辨率

这些工作流程的共同特点：

- 使用自定义文件夹树结构将输出保存在 ComfyUI 文件夹之外

我还包含了对这些工作流程有用的所有资源（手册蒙版、输入视频、结果）。

Full YouTube Walkthrough of the Workflows🌸 :

What you can do with the workflows included:

IP2P_MASKING_AUTOMATED_VID2VID:

  • Automatically mask your videos

  • Transform the shapes and textures of specific parts of your video using mask conditioning, IPAdapter, and IP2P ControlNet

  • Automatically iterate through different styles for your video without monitoring

  • Automatically add IPAdapter image descriptions directly in your prompt (using LLM)

  • Composite any background with your AI result directly in the workflow

SDXL_TURBO_STYLE_TRANSFER_VID2VID (based on Simon Lee's work):

  • Uniformize in a common style a video input composed of different styles/assets

  • Texture/stylize your video using SDXL Turbo, which allows for high quality and adherence

  • Automatically adjust colorimetry based on the input image style

  • Upscale your input video resolution with an upscaler and multi-pass KSampler

Common features of these workflows:

- Save your output outside the ComfyUI Folder with a custom folder tree structure

I have also included all the assets useful for these Workflows (Manuals Masks, Input Videos, Results).

If you have trouble with these Workflows, please contact me onmy Instagram ;)

Good luck and Have Fun!

Shoutout to all the awesome devs behind the custom nodes used in these workflows! Don't forget to star their GitHub projects! 😄
